d: The contestants go to the Hurlingham Academy and meet image consultant Vernon Francois for a challenge in which they decorate t-shirts and talk about their insecurities in a motivational speech for the school's students.
The contestants shoot a mock commercial for Alcatel, where they pretend to talk to their lover over the phone with a script written in French.
The contestants meet TV presenter Laura Whitmore for a posing challenge in Carnaby Street under the pouring rain while passersby vote on their favorite contestants.

The remaining contestants take on a catwalk challenge for TRESemmé, walking on a plexiglass runway covered in water. Lisa is chosen as the best performer, winning a year’s worth of TRESemmé products and hair services at the Daniel Galvin salon.

The contestants meet journalist Gordon Smart and participate in a press challenge where they write a 60-second skit regarding their opinions of the other contestants, which they later present in front of the camera.

Letitia, Lisa, and Roxanne receive a second set of makeovers. The contestants meet with Elle at Hyde Park, where they learn that the remaining five contestants will be traveling to Canada for the remainder of the competition.
The remaining five contestants fly to Toronto, where they take on the CN Tower's EdgeWalk before moving into their home at the SoHo Metropolitan Hotel.
Star of The Hills and America's Next Top Model judge Kelly Cutrone gives the contenders a grilling in Toronto ahead of next week's final.
Elle Macpherson and the judges join the three finalists on a Toronto beach for a tribal-themed shoot. The remaining two then take part in a fashion show where one of the girls is crowned the winner.

Dannii Minogue joins host Elle Macpherson and Tyson Beckford as 28 hopefuls begin their battle for a modelling contract with a leading agency. The girls pull out all the stops but only half of them will survive the cull.
The contestants head to the National Wedding Show at Birmingham's NEC to be coached in the art of the catwalk by model Jade Parfitt.

It's time for the contestants to receive their makeovers and host Elle Macpherson embraces the challenge by opting for a new look herself. After their transformations, the girls pose like professional gymnasts with Olympian Louis Smith.
Chemistry with the camera is imperative for a top model, so to separate the sizzlers from the fizzlers, the girls must pose with male models.
Elle Macpherson shares her top tips in a modelling workshop before Tyson challenges the girls to shine on a shoot in an ex-coal mine.
The final ten sample the flamboyant world of high fashion in a catwalk show with unusual accessories, before bearing all for a nude shoot.
The contestants demonstrate their acting skills in milk commercials before taking part in a photoshoot inspired by classic children's stories.

Journalist Hilary Alexander quizzes the would-be catwalk stars on the industry they are so eager to become part of. The winners are treated to a party with former contestants including last year's winner Letitia Herod.
